description: This file defines the 'soap_transport_http' class, which implements HTTP and HTTPS transport mechanisms for a SOAP client, including connection setup, request sending, response parsing, authentication, and handling of compression and cookies.

classes.name: soap_transport_http
classes.description: Implements HTTP/HTTPS transport for SOAP messages, including connection management, request transmission, response handling, authentication, and compression support.

methods.name: soap_transport_http
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the transport with a URL and sets default headers.

methods.name: setURL
methods.description: Parses the provided URL and sets relevant connection parameters and headers.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a socket or CURL connection based on the URL scheme (HTTP, HTTPS).

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends the SOAP message data over the established connection and retrieves the response.

methods.name: sendHTTPS
methods.description: Sends a SOAP message via HTTPS using CURL.

methods.name: setCredentials
methods.description: Sets authentication credentials for the request, supporting Basic, Digest, and certificate-based auth.

methods.name: setEncoding
methods.description: Configures HTTP Accept-Encoding headers for compression.

methods.name: buildPayload
methods.description: Constructs the complete HTTP request payload with headers and body.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Transmits the constructed HTTP request to the server.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Reads and processes the server's HTTP response, handling headers, cookies, encoding, and chunked transfer if necessary.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the Content-Type header for the request.

methods.name: usePersistentConnection
methods.description: Attempts to configure the connection for persistent use (HTTP/1.1).

methods.name: parseCookie
methods.description: Parses a Set-Cookie string into its components.

methods.name: getCookiesForRequest
methods.description: Generates Cookie header string from stored cookies, filtering by domain, path, expiry, and security.
